# IntellicatAI

> IntellicatAI is a cyber-themed AI coding assistant, developer workspace, and multi-grade STEM learning platform engineered with dual-intelligence reasoning and VIP priority acceleration.

## Overview
IntellicatAI provides developers, students, and creators with two conversational modes:
- **Normal Talk**: Natural, conversational, and versatile problem solving.
- **Cyber Cat Code Engine**: Hyper-focused technical code generation, debugging, refactoring, and software architecture guidance.

## Core Modules & Features

### 1. Dual Intelligence AI Assistant
- Ultra-low latency responses with real-time streaming.
- Dual reasoning engine with switchable Fast (lightweight) and Deep Reasoning (complex logic) execution modes.
- Code block syntax highlighting, one-click copy, and integrated execution sandboxes.
- Voice input / speech recognition integration for hands-free coding assistance.

### 2. Project Spaces
- Cloud-backed multi-file project workspaces.
- Real-time directory tree management and virtual file system.
- Code preview and automated workspace-wide intelligence.

### 3. Study Mode
- Curriculum-tailored learning paths spanning primary to advanced academic tiers:
  - Class 1 to Class 5 (Foundational logic & math)
  - Class 6 to Class 10 (Secondary STEM, sciences & algebraic computation)
  - Class 11 to Class 12 (Advanced calculus, physics, chemistry, and CS)
  - College & University (Data structures, algorithms, engineering, systems)
- Step-by-step Socratic breakdowns with interactive quizzes.

### 4. VIP Priority Access & Latency Pipeline
- Dedicated compute priority with guaranteed sub-100ms first-token latency.
- Custom API key integration (Groq, Gemini, and open models).
- Founder serial badges and exclusive priority tier benefits.
